prompt: Hero is UTG with QsTc on Jd-7c-3h-2s after BB checks the turn. Hero has live equity and a medium range edge, but not enough pressure to build the pot. Choose the best action.
why_v1: Call realizes live equity with a medium range edge while keeping the pot controlled.
feedback_correct_v1: Correct. Calling fits because live equity and a medium edge support a controlled continue, not forced pressure.
feedback_incorrect_v1: Incorrect. Raising overstates the medium edge, while folding gives up live equity; the controlled call realizes best.
